**Finding: compliant** (rule AUDIT, § 4.4, paragraph p0059).

The only audit right running against Corio is § 4.4 "Audit Rights," and it already sits at or near our preferred position:

- **Frequency:** no more than once each calendar year ✔
- **Timing/notice:** at reasonable times and upon reasonable notice ✔ (business-hours equivalent)
- **Auditor:** independent CPA reasonably acceptable to Corio ✔
- **Cost:** Commerce One bears all costs, shifting only on an underpayment >5% ✔ (preferred threshold, better than the 10% fallback)
- **System access:** limited to books and records of amounts payable — no direct or remote access to Corio systems, so no walk-away trigger ✔

Two sub-elements fall short of the ideal wording but are not material deviations and were not redlined: notice is "reasonable" rather than a fixed 30 (or fallback 15) days in writing, and the auditor is not expressly required to be bound by confidentiality. These are worth raising only if the agreement is otherwise being reopened.
